address: Kattenburg (Marineterrein), Amsterdam: 1782 brick wings on Kattenburgerstraat and the canal
notes: Four-storey 1782 brick wings, two parallel ranges. Street (north, 344 deg) wings from the 2024-12-10 panorama (w02-344, rectified, 14 window axes, three rows visible above a 4 m boundary wall that hides the ground floor, white-framed small-pane sashes, white cornice, dark brown brick); canal (south, 164 deg) wings from the 2021-01-22 panorama (w01-164, 14 axes, four rows, lighter yellow-brown brick in sun, wrought iron fence in front). Colours differ between the two photos because of sun and brick weathering; the south wings use the sunlit tone, the north the shaded one.

Not modelled: the barred round-headed ground-floor openings in the boundary wall, the roof dormers, the downpipes, the blind 15th axis at the north wing's right end. Western and eastern gable ends, the rooftop volumes at 19.7 m (panels 49/164/75/64/51) and the courtyard walls have no panorama and are left blank. Name of the institution not established from the sources used.
